preconditions.description: M is a positive integer greater than 1 and less than or equal to 500.
N is a positive integer greater than 1 and less than or equal to 500.
M and N are coprime numbers, meaning they have no common divisors other than 1.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(1, max(M, N)) if i not in reachable_indices)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of 1 for each index i in the range from 1 to the maximum of M and N that is not in the set of reachable indices starting from 0 using jumps of size M or N.
